headline: Frontline Bases Shift Amid Heavy Losses
war_summary: Three hours on the map shows the fiercest sectors easing their base turnover while the butcher’s bill climbs. Weathered Expanse, still the bloodiest theatre, has slipped to fifty ownership changes in the last day from fifty‑eight, yet colonial and Warden dead each rose by roughly eight hundred. Linn Mercy added one more flip to reach thirty‑seven, though the two‑hour surge has fallen to a little over a hundred colonial and two‑seventy Warden casualties. Nevish Line surged to forty‑seven exchanges, up from thirty‑nine, with both sides shedding over a thousand men in the past two hours. Mooring County’s activity has halved to eight flips, its casualties now modest at forty‑eight colonial and twenty‑two Warden. Stonecradle holds at fourteen flips, the two‑hour toll roughly sixty each side. Marban Hollow has gone quiet, recording no base changes and only light losses. Rear‑area hexes such as Callahans Passage and Dead Lands remain static, bleeding heavily without territorial shift. Enlistments continue a modest rise in the active zones, feeding fresh manpower into the grinder.
